description:
Software installed on a host, from the openITCOCKPIT agent's inventory. OS is auto-detected (Linux, Windows, macOS).

A host carries hundreds to thousands of packages. Pass name_filter to search by
package name, or only_updatable=True for just the outdated ones. For updates across
the whole estate use list_pending_updates or list_pending_security_updates.

A host with no agent inventory at all raises, rather than returning zero rows.

hostname.description: Exact host name. Required - there is no estate-wide form of this tool. A name that matches no host is answered with the tools that can find the right one.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to 50, maximum 500.

name_filter.description: Substring to search for in the name. Empty returns everything, capped by limit.

name: list_installed_software

outputSchema.description: Rows plus enough context to know whether they are all of them.

hint.description: How to narrow the query when truncated.

items.description: The rows, at most `limit` of them.

truncated.description: True if openITCOCKPIT held more rows than were returned.

title: Installed Software
